description: This file defines types, constants, and functions related to provider attribution policies, endpoint resolution, and request capabilities for various AI service providers within the OpenClaw project.

methods.name: formatOpenClawUserAgent
methods.description: Formats the User-Agent string for OpenClaw with the given version.

methods.name: tryParseHostname
methods.description: Attempts to parse a hostname from a string URL.

methods.name: isSchemelessHostnameCandidate
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid schemeless hostname candidate.

methods.name: resolveUrlHostname
methods.description: Resolves the hostname from a URL string or schemeless hostname.

methods.name: normalizeComparableBaseUrl
methods.description: Normalizes a base URL for comparison purposes.

methods.name: isLocalEndpointHost
methods.description: Determines if a hostname is considered a local endpoint.

methods.name: resolveProviderEndpoint
methods.description: Resolves the provider endpoint class and hostname based on a base URL.

methods.name: resolveKnownProviderFamily
methods.description: Maps provider identifiers to known provider family categories.

methods.name: resolveProviderAttributionIdentity
methods.description: Returns the product and version identity for attribution.

methods.name: buildOpenRouterAttributionPolicy
methods.description: Constructs the attribution policy for OpenRouter.

methods.name: buildOpenAIAttributionPolicy
methods.description: Constructs the attribution policy for OpenAI.

methods.name: buildOpenAICodexAttributionPolicy
methods.description: Constructs the attribution policy for OpenAI Codex.

methods.name: buildSdkHookOnlyPolicy
methods.description: Builds a provider attribution policy for SDK hooks.

methods.name: listProviderAttributionPolicies
methods.description: Lists all available provider attribution policies.

methods.name: resolveProviderAttributionPolicy
methods.description: Resolves the attribution policy for a given provider.

methods.name: resolveProviderAttributionHeaders
methods.description: Gets attribution headers for a provider if enabled.

methods.name: resolveProviderRequestPolicy
methods.description: Resolves the request policy including endpoint class and attribution details.

methods.name: resolveProviderRequestAttributionHeaders
methods.description: Gets attribution headers for a request policy input.

methods.name: resolveProviderRequestCapabilities
methods.description: Determines the capabilities and compatibility of a provider request.
